notes: Medium (sum 14): the agent must fetch both crew members' calendars over HTTP from a live roster service using bearer-token auth so the saved .ics files are fresh (per-process session id byte-check), then parse the fetched ICS and compute exact per-person watch stats and a pairwise cross-crew overlap in minutes. Hidden cases (different tokens/terminals/keys/base dates, an empty-watch crew member, touching vs overlapping intervals) force generalized, not hard-coded behavior. Difficulty comes from the two dependent stages (live fetch -> summary derived from the fetched bytes), stateful HTTP interaction with token auth, and exact quantitative semantics.
